description: This file defines API endpoints for managing a shopping cart in a food delivery backend. It uses FastAPI for routing and SQLAlchemy for database operations, providing functionality to view, add/update, and remove cart items for users with the customer role.

classes.name: CartItemResponse
classes.description: Schema for cart item data sent in responses.

classes.name: CartItemUpsertRequest
classes.description: Schema for the request to add or update a cart item.

methods.name: list[CartItemResponse] get_cart( db: Session = Depends(get_db), user: User = Depends(require_role(UserRole.customer)), )
methods.description: Retrieves all cart items for the current user.

methods.name: CartItemResponse upsert_cart_item( payload: CartItemUpsertRequest, db: Session = Depends(get_db), user: User = Depends(require_role(UserRole.customer)), )
methods.description: Adds a new item to the cart or updates an existing one.

methods.name: None remove_cart_item( cart_item_id: int, db: Session = Depends(get_db), user: User = Depends(require_role(UserRole.customer)), )
methods.description: Removes a specified cart item belonging to the user.

ctags.name: get_cart
ctags.signature: ( db: Session = Depends(get_db), user: User = Depends(require_role(UserRole.customer)), )

ctags.name: remove_cart_item
ctags.signature: ( cart_item_id: int, db: Session = Depends(get_db), user: User = Depends(require_role(UserRole.customer)), )

ctags.name: upsert_cart_item
ctags.signature: ( payload: CartItemUpsertRequest, db: Session = Depends(get_db), user: User = Depends(require_role(UserRole.customer)), )
